findings.title: Uploads return a public URL from `chat-uploads` and trust client-declared content type
findings.note: New at a62e44a; no server-side magic-byte sniff and bucket visibility is unverified server-side.
evidence: apps/api/src/validators/upload.ts: client contentType allowlist + extension blocklist
getPublicUrl implies public access if the bucket is public
findings.impact: Malware/HTML/SVG polyglot upload or unauthenticated read of attachments if the bucket is public.
findings.recommendation: Sniff magic bytes server-side, block SVG/HTML, and use private buckets with short-lived signed download URLs.

findings.title: No per-tenant/user quota or total-storage cap on uploads
findings.note: Only a 10MB per-file cap is enforced.
findings.recommendation: Add per-user quota and a cleanup/retention job (worker cleanup exists for other data).

report:
Reviewed `validators/upload.ts`, the
`/messages/upload` handler and storage bucket usage. Validation is a
client-declared content-type + extension blocklist; uploads return a public
URL from the `chat-uploads` bucket.
